title: Communication troubleshooting
desc: Your devices time out, disconnect or behave inconsistently, and nobody can say why.
detail:
We make the failure reproducible, isolate where it starts across software, configuration and the interface, and agree the fix and how to validate it.

You receive a reproducible test, written findings, corrective actions in priority order and an agreed validation. The work is remote. On-site wiring repair, protocol certification and a guarantee of zero downtime are not included.

title: Historian integration
desc: Production or laboratory data reaches your historian incomplete, duplicated or with inconsistent timestamps, or someone still copies it by hand.
detail:
We agree the sources, the target, the tag mapping, the timestamps and what happens when a link fails. Then we build the data path and validate it against that agreement.

You receive the integration component, the mapping specification, validation evidence and operating guidance. Third-party licences are not included, and no component is promised to fit every system.

title: Protocol testing
desc: Each release waits for a hardware bench and manual test runs, and failure paths rarely get tested at all.
detail:
We agree the protocol subset and the behaviour to prove, failure paths included, and build tests that run without the full hardware setup and repeat on every release.

You receive the test suite, the agreed scenarios, reproducible results and instructions to run them. Simulation complements hardware testing. It does not prove full hardware compatibility or replace formal certification.
projects: Automated Test Suite — Modbus RTU/TCP Server/Client · Hilscher
